invite.subject: {{by}} invites you to {{app}}
invite.body: {{by}} invites you to {{app}}. The button below makes your account. The invitation holds for {{valid}}.

invite_space.subject: {{by}} invites you to {{space}} in {{app}}
invite_space.body: {{by}} invites you to {{space}} in {{app}}. The button below makes your account. The invitation holds for {{valid}}.

reset.subject: A new password for {{app}}
reset.body: A link for a new password was made for your account {{username}}. It holds for {{valid}} and works once. If that was not you, just leave this mail.

confirm_email.subject: Confirm your address for {{app}}
confirm_email.body: Confirm with the button that this address belongs to your account {{username}}. The link holds for {{valid}}.

email_changed.subject: Your address at {{app}} was changed
email_changed.body: The address of your account {{username}} is now {{hint}}. If that was not you, ask the operator.

email_removed.subject: Your address at {{app}} was removed
email_removed.body: Your account {{username}} has no address any more. If that was not you, ask the operator.

username_changed.subject: Your username at {{app}}
username_changed.body: Your username is now {{username}}. You sign in with it from now on.

factor_reset.subject: Your second factor at {{app}} was reset
factor_reset.body: The operator removed the second factor of your account {{username}}. Set up a new one after your next sign-in. If you did not ask for this, ask the operator.

new_sign_in.subject: New sign-in at {{app}}
new_sign_in.body: Your account {{username}} was just signed in from a new browser: {{where}}. If that was you, all is well. Otherwise change your password and sign out everywhere.

test.subject: Test mail from {{app}}
test.body: If you read this, {{app}} can send mail.
